## About
Starr Automotive Truck & RV is a car repair and maintenance shop on Cherry Ave in Long Beach. We work on everyday cars, trucks and RVs, so whether it's the car you drive to work or the motorhome you take on the road, you can bring it here.
The easiest way to get started is to call and tell us what's going on. We hold a 4.1 rating from 40 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car repair and maintenance: Repair and maintenance for your everyday car.
- Trucks: We work on trucks as well as cars. Call us with what your truck needs.
- RV and motorhome work: Work on RVs and motorhomes, so you can get back on the road.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks and RVs, including motorhomes.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Give us a call and tell us what your car, truck or RV needs.
